## Oak Exploratory Data Analysis and Cleaning

```{r}
#install.packages("tidyverse")
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#got thid code by clicking the file on the right then import then copy code and cancel (don't acc import)
library(readxl)
Survival_HeightApril26Blocks7_6Clean <- read_excel("Oak Project/Data/Survival_HeightApril26Blocks7&6Clean.xlsx", 
                                                   sheet = "Input1", skip = 1)
#skip got rid of the first row bc it was duplicated using the shortcut, but we couldve also gotten rid of it after importing using "slice"
View(Survival_HeightApril26Blocks7_6Clean)
```

```{r}
#clean each shee, first view the column names
names(Survival_HeightApril26Blocks7_6Clean)
```

```{r}
#now change column names
Survival_HeightApril26Blocks7_6Clean <- 
  rename( Page_num = "Page #",
         Date = "MM/DD/YYYY",
          Recorder = "Name",
         Block = "#...4",
         = "#...5",
         Oak_type = "NR, S, or A",
        Treatment  = "AC, OA, NP, DT, or DL",
        Oa_microclimate  = "TH, TI, CN",
         Seedling_Ht_cm = "(cm)",
          = "#...10",
          = "#...11",
          = "%",
          = "#...13",
          = "(mm)",
          = "as written on data sheet")
```
